description: This Harvard Dataverse dataset provides raw pulse-echo ground-penetrating radar measurements over three concrete step specimens tested at BAM in Berlin. The specimens have stepped thicknesses and known embedded contents: one without inserts, one with tendon ducts and one with polystyrene cuboids. The article specifies 1.5 and 2.6 GHz bistatic antennas and automated high-density scanning. The public Dataverse version lists three specimen ZIP archives under CC0 1.0. These reference measurements can test geometry or internal-element detection methods that later inform bridge or building assessment; they are not in-service bridge scans or evidence of ageing. Laboratory specimen geometry, antenna choice and controlled scan conditions limit transfer to wet, reinforced or damaged structures. A reviewer-assessed use is checking nondestructive-survey components in structural digital twins. model-opensees is a related structural simulation model, but no GPR-to-material or geometry conversion was tested. No archive was downloaded. Coverage is limited to the three named laboratory specimens.
